edits.old: Then no metadata or content is returned

Then no metadata or content is returned

  Scenario: AC13 Caller without the Documents right (new in rwb-document; X10)
    Given a capacity and workforce planner with role RW-CAPACITY who has no Documents right
    When the planner requests the court notice from AC1
    Then the system refuses the request with 403 and MSG-P4-002
    Then no metadata or content is returned

  Scenario: AC14 Decision record write fails (new in rwb-document; X11, BR8)
    Given the decision record write is forced to fail
    When a court notice is stored for case "RW-2026-000123"
    Then nothing is stored
    Then an incident is raised (R-UNI-39) and the system refuses the store with MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC15 Case contract does not answer (new in rwb-document; X12)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer within 2 s
    When a court notice is stored for case "RW-2026-000123"
    Then the system refuses the store with 503 and MSG-GEN-006
    Then nothing is stored and the circuit breaker shields the case service

  Scenario: AC16 Outbox relay down at commit (new in rwb-document; X13)
    Given the outbox relay is down
    When a court notice is stored for case "RW-2026-000123"
    Then the row, the fields, the decision record and the outbox row are committed together
    Then the relay publishes DocumentStored once when it recovers, with no duplicate store

  Scenario: AC17 Empty state of the case documents screen (new in rwb-document; SCR-30)
    Given case "RW-2026-000123" has no document rows
    When the case documents screen SCR-30 is opened for the case
    Then the screen shows the empty state with a message Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P5-E1024-APP-10)

  Scenario: AC18 Loading state of the case documents screen (new in rwb-document; SCR-30)
    Given the document list of case "RW-2026-000123" is being fetched
    When the case documents screen SCR-30 is opened for the case
    Then the screen shows the loading state until the list returns

  Scenario: AC19 Error state of the case documents screen (new in rwb-document; SCR-30)
    Given the document list read for case "RW-2026-000123" fails
    When the case documents screen SCR-30 is opened for the case
    Then the screen shows the error state with a message Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P5-E1024-APP-10)

  Scenario: AC20 No-access state of the case documents screen (new in rwb-document; SCR-30)
    Given a caller whose role lacks the Documents right
    When the case documents screen SCR-30 is opened for case "RW-2026-000123"
    Then the screen shows the no-access state and the system refuses the request with 403 and MSG-P4-002
